mechanics.claim: While inside the mist, Gwen gains bonus armor and magic resistance and is untargetable to enemies outside the mist.
mechanics.quote: gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} and is {{tip|untargetable}} to all enemies (except {{tip|turret|turrets}} and {{tip|monsters}}) outside of the mist.

mechanics.claim: Gwen does not take damage from monsters that hit her while outside the mist.
mechanics.quote: '''Gwen''' will not take damage from monsters that hit her and are outside of the mist.

mechanics.claim: All targeted projectiles from enemy champions outside the mist are destroyed upon reaching or entering the mist.
mechanics.quote: All {{tip|projectile|projectiles}} targeted at '''Gwen''' by enemy champions outside the mist are {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroyed}} upon attempting to pass through the mist or being inside the mist.
